notes.zh-CN: 修复关闭后仍打开旧版本：下载完成并退出后，会等进程结束再静默安装；支持断点续传。
notes.en-US: Fix: quit waits for WePic to exit before silent install so the next launch is new. Downloads can resume after restart.

zh-CN.title: 修复
items: 下载完成后关闭再打开仍是旧版本：现已等进程完全退出后再静默安装
安装包下载中断后可续传，不必从头下

en-US.title: Fixes
items: After a finished download, quitting no longer left you on the old build—install waits until WePic has fully exited
Interrupted installer downloads resume instead of starting over

zh-CN.title: 功能
items: 更新下载完成后不再打断使用；关闭后会静默安装，下次打开即为新版本
AI 翻译可选择目标语言：中文、英文，或跟随界面语言

zh-CN.title: 改进
items: 界面中英文切换更完整
浅色主题下更新记录文字更清晰
设置与图片信息等窗口体验优化

en-US.title: Features
items: Updates download in the background without interrupting you; they install when you quit, and the next launch uses the new version
Choose AI translation target: Chinese, English, or follow the UI language

en-US.title: Improvements
items: More complete Chinese / English UI coverage
Clearer update-history text in light theme
Smoother Settings and image-information dialogs

zh-CN.title: 功能
items: 启动后可自动检查更新，并在后台下载
下载完成后可自动安装并重新打开 WePic
设置 → 关于 可随时查看更新记录

zh-CN.title: 改进
items: 更新窗口外观与设置界面一致
更新说明改成更通俗的表述，方便了解改了什么

en-US.title: Features
items: Auto-check for updates after launch, with background download
When ready, install and reopen WePic automatically
Open update history anytime from Settings → About

en-US.title: Improvements
items: Update window looks consistent with Settings
Release notes rewritten in plain language
